name: Fix stacked ghost copies in the light shafts (banding)
body:
Dean's screenshot (a floating slab seen against the lit sky, a platform lit from the left) shows the slab's outline repeated as a stack of translucent copies below it, and a hard-edged glow patch under a lit face.

Cause, checked by compiling `composite.frag` with the shafts forced off: the ghost copies and the stepped sky are the light shafts. Every pixel walks 24 evenly spaced steps towards the sun, so a blocker is seen only at whole steps and its outline is repeated a step apart. Reproduced on the hand-off prototype room on lavapipe (vertical bands across the sky) and gone with shafts off.

Fix: start each pixel's walk a different fraction of a step along (interleaved gradient noise), so the copies turn into fine grain. See the decision in `docs/decisions.md`.
